full_judgment: 3. The respondent No.6 opposed the Rule by filing an affidavit-in-opposition sworn on 2.7.05. It is stated in the affidavit-in-opposition that respondent No.6 Ayon Ali Howlader had taken pattan of the case land from Syed Hatem Ali in 1949 who has been running his grocery shop after constructing a tin shad with pucca floor thereon since then. Thereafter when the case land had been decided as Government Khas land he applied for taking settlement of the same and accordingly settlement case No: 22KT/71-72 was started. After complying with the necessary formalities the A.D.C. (Rev) has correctly executed and registered the deed of settlement of the case land on 21.11.96 in his favour. But on wrong notion Additional Divisional Commissioner rejected the said settlement case against who roof as per proper legal forum he went to the land Appeal Board with an appeal and the Chairman of the Land Appeal Board After proper appreciation of law and facts set aside the 4 said order as well as affirmed the same in review accordingly committed no illegality.
